headings.notes: Generous letter spacing, elegant editorial feel. Used for H1, H2, H3.

body.notes: Clean, highly legible body font for contrast with the serif headers.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-navy/10 or border-white/10 depending on background
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to keep the 'bem limpinho' editorial look
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal. Deep solid navy blue and pure white fields.
visual_enhancers.wave_motif: Use a minimal SVG wave for the logo and section transitions.

layouts.marketing_page: Generous padding (py-24 to py-32). Content is not constrained to standard containers; mix centered editorial text with full-width image bands and bento grids for products.
layouts.product_grids: Bento-style or wide editorial masonry for Car & Clothes packs. High quality images with subtle zoom on hover.
layouts.student_admin_area: High-density grid layout (gap-4). Uses a sidebar for navigation (Courses, Access Grants, Products). Clean Shadcn tables for CRUD operations.
layouts.course_player: Two-column layout: 70% video player (16:9 aspect ratio) with lesson details, 30% lesson sidebar/playlist. Deep navy background for focus mode.

motion.hero: Framer motion line-by-line text reveal for the main headline.
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling to give the site a premium editorial weight.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax (10-15% movement) on the large product showcase images.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee used for a slow, editorial ribbon ('ocean studio • fivem • gta rp • curso de hl') with Playfair Display font.
motion.interactions: Hover micro-interactions: slight image scale (scale-105) and image brightness shift. Buttons: hover:bg-white/10 for dark sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on deep navy background passes APCA/WCAG. Text over images must have a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for decorative waves and marquee.

components.button: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Primary: Deep Navy bg, White text. 'Comprar no Discord': Discord Purple bg, White text with Discord icon.
components.cards: Minimalist, cardless look. Image is dominant, with text directly underneath rather than enclosed in a visible border.
components.navbar: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if on white, or Solid Navy if over navy. Must have the wave logo, 'Cursos', 'Packs', 'Entrar'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body. Add them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the 'Bem limpinho' editorial aesthetic: Large sections of deep solid navy (#0A192F) alternating with pure white sections (#FFFFFF).
Use generous letter-spacing on headings to achieve the editorial look.
Create a minimal SVG wave for the Ocean Studio logo and use it in the nav, footer, and favicon.
Implement line-by-line reveal animations for the main hero text using framer-motion.
Add a slow, editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee.
For the products (Car/Clothes packs), use a minimalist bento grid. Each product must have a 'Comprar no Discord' button linking out.
The Student Area and Admin Panel must use clean Shadcn components with sharp or max 2px rounded corners.
Build the Course Player with a 70/30 split layout (Video on left, Lesson list on right).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Create depth through layered design and editorial layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-16, p-24) than feels comfortable to maintain the premium editorial feel.
Never use generic placeholder images or missing text. Use the provided image URLs.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers where content scrolls underneath.
